# Code of Conduct

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful, assume good intent, give constructive feedback, and no harassment of any kind. Everyone is welcome regardless of experience level, background or identity.

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to the maintainer through a [GitHub security advisory](https://github.com/francordel/kdemos/security/advisories/new). Reports are handled confidentially, and the maintainer may remove comments, close PRs or block users who break these rules.
